page_title: ALA 2-2 OSA | Alaves v Osasuna 05/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' Angel Perez (Alaves) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+3' Asier Osambela (Osasuna) is given a red card for some unsportsmanlike conduct off the pitch.
90+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Lucas Boye (Alaves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Sergio Herrera into the bottom left corner.
90+1' Lucas Boye (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Alaves!
89' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Alaves! Let's see what he decides.
87' Toni Martinez (Alaves) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
87' Toni Martinez (Alaves) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Sergio Herrera is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
87' The attendance is 17736.
87' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
86' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Cesar Soto Grado signals.
85' Alessio Lisci decides to make a substitution. Ante Budimir will be replaced by Jorge Herrando (Osasuna).
83' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pablo Ibanez as he is replaced by Lucas Boye (Alaves).
80' 1 - 2 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Antonio Sivera into the bottom right corner.
80' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
79' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle after Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Osasuna!
77' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Aimar Oroz is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
77' Lucas Torro will be replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
77' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a change. Abel Bretones (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Garcia.
76' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
75' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
73' Substitution. Ibrahim Diabate is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
72' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle after Javi Galan (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
70' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off his line to gather the ball.
68' Javi Galan (Osasuna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
66' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is flagged for offside.
66' Javi Galan (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
64' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
63' Angel Perez (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
61' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
60' It is time for a substitution. Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is on for Kike Barja.
60' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
57' Carles Alena (Alaves) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the left post.

56' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
55' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Alaves.
55' A pass into the penalty area from Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is intercepted by the defence.
53' Toni Martinez (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
53' The foul by Kike Barja (Osasuna) was seen by Cesar Soto Grado who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
51' The corner from Jonny Otto (Alaves) is intercepted by the defence.
50' Angel Perez (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Alaves will take a corner.

49' Ambitious effort from Pablo Ibanez (Alaves). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
49' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
47' Flag up against Ante Budimir (Osasuna). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Yusi comes off for Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
46' Quique Sanchez Flores makes a switch. Carles Alena (Alaves) is coming on in place of Jon Guridi at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' 1 - 1 Toni Martinez (Alaves) meets a perfect cross from Antonio Blanco deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the right post. The score is 1:1.
41' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
41' That's a clear yellow card. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) goes into the book.
39' Osasuna players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
37' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner but it's cleared.
36' Antonio Sivera pulls off a brilliant save! Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. Osasuna get a corner.
35' The resulting corner, taken by Jon Guridi (Alaves), comes to nothing.
35' Angel Perez (Alaves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
33' 49:51 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
31' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post.
30' Jon Guridi (Alaves) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.

29' Toni Martinez (Alaves) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the right side of the goal but for a magnificent save by Sergio Herrera.
28' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) commits a foul after dangerous play. Alaves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
27' Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
27' Jon Guridi (Alaves) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
26' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' The linesman signals that Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

23' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Cesar Soto Grado with no other option than to blow for a foul.
21' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
18' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul after Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) hacks down one of his opponents.

17' Angel Perez (Alaves) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
16' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
16' Yusi (Alaves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
14' This shall not pass! Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
13' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
12' The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
12' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
11' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Toni Martinez (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Kike Barja (Osasuna) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
7' Dangerous play by Yusi (Alaves). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
6' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jon Guridi (Alaves). The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Yusi (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Kike Barja produces a great pass that finds Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot high into the net. 0:1.
2' Kike Barja (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Osasuna will take the kick-off.
